Class WorkerController

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.controller.WorkerController
public class WorkerController extends Object
Handles worker/staff-facing API calls coming from the networking layer.

This controller is a thin routing layer between incoming Message objects and the worker-related service classes:

  • WorkerService - authentication and worker account creation
  • OpenTimeService - restaurant opening hours (regular + special days)
  • TableService - table layout (capacities/quantities) management

Each method extracts and casts the request payload from Message.getData(), delegates to the relevant service, and wraps the result into a response Message using the appropriate APICallType value.

Payload contracts (what message.getData() must contain):

  • login(Message): WorkerAuth
  • createWorker(Message): WorkerNewRequest
  • addSpecialDay(Message): SpecialDayRequest
  • editRegulaDay(Message): BistroTimeDTO
  • updateTables(Message): List<TableRequest>

Singleton: implemented as a singleton so the server uses one controller instance.

Author:
Andrei Beloziyorove

    • login

      public com.andreibel.message.Message login(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Authenticates a worker (staff login).

      Expected payload: WorkerAuth (e.g., username/id + password).

      Response:

      • WORKER_LOGIN_RESPONSE with WorkerResponse on success
      • WORKER_LOGIN_ERROR with null payload on failure
      Parameters:
      message - request message containing WorkerAuth
      Returns:
      response message with authentication result

    • createWorker

      public com.andreibel.message.Message createWorker(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Creates a new worker account.

      Expected payload: WorkerNewRequest describing the new worker.

      Response:

      • WORKER_CREATE_RESPONSE with WorkerResponse on success
      • WORKER_CREATE_ERROR with null payload on failure
      Parameters:
      message - request message containing WorkerNewRequest
      Returns:
      response message with created worker data

    • addSpecialDay

      public com.andreibel.message.Message addSpecialDay(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Adds a "special day" opening-hours record (date-specific override).

      Expected payload: SpecialDayRequest containing the date and opening-hours details.

      Response: returns ADD_SPECIAL_DAY_RESPONSE with null payload. If you want error reporting, consider catching service exceptions and returning ADD_SPECIAL_DAY_ERROR.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing SpecialDayRequest
      Returns:
      response message acknowledging the operation

    • editRegulaDay

      public com.andreibel.message.Message editRegulaDay(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Updates the regular (default) restaurant opening hours.

      Expected payload: BistroTimeDTO describing regular open/close times and interval.

      Response: returns CHANGE_BISTRO_TIME_RESPONSE with null payload.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing BistroTimeDTO
      Returns:
      response message acknowledging the operation

    • getAllTables

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getAllTables()
      Retrieves the current table layout configuration.

      Response:

      • GET_ALL_TABLES_RESPONSE with List<TableResponse> when data exists
      • GET_ALL_TABLES_ERROR with null payload if no tables are found
      Returns:
      response message containing table layout data or an error type

    • updateTables

      public com.andreibel.message.Message updateTables(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Updates the table layout configuration.

      Expected payload: List<TableRequest> describing the desired layout.

      This method validates that Message.getData() is a List before casting. If the payload is not a list, EDIT_BISTRO_LAYOUT_ERROR is returned.

      Response: returns EDIT_BISTRO_LAYOUT_RESPONSE with null payload on success.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing List<TableRequest>
      Returns:
      response message acknowledging the update or an error type

    • getRegularDate

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getRegularDate()
      Retrieves the regular (default) opening-hours configuration.

      Response: GET_REGULAR_OPEN_TIME_RESPONSE with BistroTimeDTO payload. If you want an explicit error when missing, add a null check and return GET_REGULAR_OPEN_TIME_ERROR.

      Returns:
      response message containing the regular opening-hours configuration
